## Description

Briefly describe the change and its rationale.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New component (packages/ui)
- [ ] Component fix or enhancement
- [ ] CLI enhancement (packages/cli)
- [ ] Documentation update (apps/docs)

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Strict TypeScript (no `any`, no implicit types)
- [ ] Zero comments in production TS/TSX code
- [ ] Semantic Tailwind tokens only (no hardcoded hex/RGB colors)
- [ ] Accessible keyboard navigation and visible `:focus-visible` styles
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` compliance where motion is used
- [ ] No emojis in code or commit messages
- [ ] Code builds cleanly (`pnpm build`)
